Harsil Valley: Gartang Gali & Gangotri

A quiet Himalayan valley on the Bhagirathi, the Gartang Gali skywalk, Gangotri Temple and a trek to Lama Top. A group trip from Delhi.

THE DESTINATION

About Harsil Valley

Harsil is a peaceful valley on the Bhagirathi river in Uttarkashi district, close to Gangotri and surrounded by deodar forests and snow peaks. It is much quieter than the better-known hill stations.

On this trip you walk the wooden skywalk of Gartang Gali, visit the Gangotri Temple and Surya Kund, spend a bonfire evening in Harsil, and finish with a village visit to Bagori and a 2.5 km trek to Lama Top.

Delhi
STAY

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Khedi waterfall — a stop on the drive to Harsil.

Harsil Valley stay — a relaxed evening with a bonfire.

Gartang Gali — the famous wooden skywalk, about 2.5 km of walking.

Gangotri Temple — darshan at the temple of Goddess Ganga.

Surya Kund — a short trek near Gangotri.

Bagori village — a walk through a quiet mountain village.

Lama Top — a 2.5 km trek with valley views.

Trip Captain — an experienced Trip Captain and 24x7 support.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Departure: Depart from Delhi in the evening. The pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.
  • Overnight journey: Travel overnight towards Uttarkashi and Harsil.
  • Morning: Reach Uttarkashi, freshen up and have breakfast.
  • Drive: Continue to Harsil Valley, with a stop at Khedi waterfall on the way.
  • Arrival: Reach Harsil in the evening and check in. There is a short 500 m walk to the stay.
  • Explore: If time permits, explore the local Harsil village.
  • Night: Evening bonfire, then dinner and overnight stay.
  • Morning: Wake up early and have breakfast.
  • Gartang Gali: Drive to Lanka Bridge, where the 2.5 km Gartang Gali trek begins. It is a wooden skywalk on a cliff face near the Indo-China border.
  • Gangotri: Visit the Gangotri Temple, the temple of Goddess Ganga.
  • Surya Kund: Visit Surya Kund (or Sat Tal, depending on conditions), a short trek near Gangotri.
  • Return: Head back to your stay in Harsil. Dinner and overnight stay.
  • Morning: Wake up early and have breakfast.
  • Lama Top: A 2.5 km trek to Lama Top.
  • Bagori: Visit Bagori village.
  • Departure: Board the vehicle for Delhi in the late afternoon, with a dinner stop around Rishikesh or Chamba.
  • Arrival: Reach Delhi early in the morning, with a phone full of photos and memories of Harsil Valley.
  • Trip ends: The group parts ways and the trip ends.
